'''H3-4L''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] selling his wares in the [[Training Room (Jedi Temple)|Training Room]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], using [[Coruscant Mission Token]]s as a [[Currency/Legends|currency]].

==Behind the scenes==
H3-4L first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)]]" as a consumables vendor in the Jedi Temple training room, using Coruscant Mission Tokens as a currency. The name H3-4L resembles the word "heal".
